The quarter now stands at 39 of 40 unless Lauretta's documents arrive and clear KYC in time. The Branch Manager asked for every lead converted. I told her the check can't be bypassed, and she replied only that she still needs the numbers. I've closed the shift with a handover note that says to re-run KYC if the matching ID arrives, and not to open the account or take the deposit before it's verified.
